name: docsy-public-client
description: Release-only public distribution of the Docsy SDK and CLI

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @remcp/docsy-sdk && npm run build --workspace @remcp/docsy-cli
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @remcp/docsy-sdk && npm run test --workspace @remcp/docsy-cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @remcp/docsy-sdk && npm run typecheck --workspace @remcp/docsy-cli
